criteria: Define Debouncing/Throttling policy for Redis Cache Invalidation to prevent Cache Stampede.
hint: High transaction volume will trigger constant invalidations. Should we batch cache invalidation events (e.g., invalidate merely every 30 seconds) rather than per-transaction?
placeholder: Specify 'Throttle cache eviction to max 1 per 60 seconds'.

references.info: Risk of Redis cache churn and DB overload during peak write times.

additional_info: Essential background processing mechanism to stabilize CQRS read operations.
